comparison.objective: Align a shackle around a towing lug, insert its pin, and screw it fully home; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Shackling tests three-hole alignment, threaded insertion, repeated regrasping, and tightening rather than orientation-sensitive sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Pin through all layers, collar seated and hand-tight for 1 s without dropped hardware; candidate requires ≥98% separation, washer retention, reseating, release, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Bimanual alignment and load sharing are generic commonalities; fastening hardware does not test many-body separation.
